title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1993-02-23
source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid = 1611) SBD> DAT> Sonic Solutions (for phase correction)> CD; via Mike Hall + AUD (shnid = 141067) fl1c6/44.1 Source Info: FOB Schoeps CMC 54-> DAT Transfer Info: DAT Tape (Panasonic SV-3700) -> Coxial SPDIF-> Marantz PMD 661 MKII (Solid State Recorder)-> SD Card-> Wav-> Flac Level 8-> Tagged (16/48) Transfers by Pete Ebel - matrix mixing by Kevin Tobin

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix capture of a historic show, highlighted by an extraordinary Ornette Coleman/Space segment and stellar Broken Arrow debut.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the matrix source for its deep bass response and immersive room feel, calling it a perfect blend of soundboard clarity and audience ambience. The performance shines on the second set, with the Ornette Coleman‑inspired space jam, a groundbreaking Broken Arrow debut, and an inspired Johnny B. Goode that rank among the band’s best late‑career moments.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for both musical performance (standout second set, experimental space) and recording quality (excellent matrix), offset by only two reviews which limits confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note deep bass capture, crisp soundboard detail combined with vivid audience ambience; no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as less compelling, while the second set delivers experimental brilliance with Ornette Coleman‑inspired space and powerful late‑show jams.
